Name: Shallum, Son of Kore
Summary: Chief porter, son of Kore son of Ebiasaph son of Korah, keeper of the gates of the tabernacle.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:17; 1 Chronicles 9:19: Chief porter, son of Kore son of Ebiasaph son of Korah, keeper of the gates of the tabernacle.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shallum in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
